prompt:
List the annual revenue of the listed company "Space Exploration Technologies Corp. (SpaceX)" (ticker SPCX) for EVERY fiscal year since its first publicly reported fiscal year (its IPO era) up to the latest completed fiscal year, as far back as you reliably know. Never invent or interpolate a year: stop at the earliest year you are confident about. Use the company's own fiscal-year labels, MILLIONS of reporting currency, and today's reporting basis where restated.
Reply with ONLY one JSON object: {"currency":"ISO code","years":[{"fy":"FY2001","revenue":number}, ...oldest first],"note":"one short sentence on coverage or restatements, or null"}

result.note: Audited years presented in the June 2026 IPO prospectus, with FY2023-FY2024 retrospectively recast to include X and xAI (common-control mergers); no earlier consolidated figures were published.
